witness.branch: through or within a safety zone
witness.quote: No vehicle shall at any time be driven through or within a safety zone.
witness.reason: A paved-road travel route can pass through an officially designated safety zone; zone presence alone does not establish that movement.
required_context: A constructed travel route through or within the zone.
